cases.prompt: In this repo I want threaded comments. /todo
expected_behavior: Treats bare /todo as the driver, not an advise-only status dump
Creates or resumes on-disk DAG/tickets rather than pasting a next-session prompt
Does not require /todo run as a separate opt-in

cases.prompt: Continue /todo. There are two Stage NEW tickets with disjoint Files.
expected_behavior: Spawns a subagent per implementation ticket
Runs the two disjoint low-risk tickets in parallel
Does not implement the tickets in the orchestrator session

cases.prompt: Continue /todo. The previous wave is complete but uncommitted, and one of its files is still untracked. The next ticket edits that file and adds a test. Do not commit anything.
expected_behavior: Retains a before-wave source snapshot including earlier uncommitted and untracked work
Reviews the new wave against that starting content, not only a commit-to-HEAD diff
Does not attribute unchanged earlier-ticket content to the new ticket or create a checkpoint commit

cases.prompt: /todo status says all tickets are complete. Finish the pipeline: each ticket was small, but together the proposed PR changes 900 handwritten lines across three unrelated features. Keep everything local.
expected_behavior: Checks the aggregate proposed PR rather than accepting per-ticket size as sufficient
Recommends a split by coherent feature with supporting tests kept together
Does not automatically create branches, rewrite history, or publish PRs

cases.prompt: /todo handoff so I can continue in a new chat.
expected_behavior: Replies with the absolute path and a few sentences
Does not emit a fenced paste-ready prompt of the handoff
